description: Figure 8(d) illustrates the performance of knowledge probing on Qwen2.5 with different editing methods. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10<sup>1</sup> to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 10<sup>1</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Five lines are present in the plot. The “Base” line is green with circular markers and shows a steady increase from approximately 63% at a co-occurrence number of 10 to approximately 73% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The “MEND” line is purple with square markers and begins at approximately 68% at a co-occurrence number of 10, rises to approximately 78% at a co-occurrence number of 100, and then plateaus around 79% until a co-occurrence number of 1000. The “MEMIT” line is orange with diamond markers and starts at approximately 65% at a co-occurrence number of 10, increases to approximately 76% at a co-occurrence number of 100, and then plateaus around 76% until a co-occurrence number of 1000. The “FT” line is red with triangular markers and begins at approximately 66% at a co-occurrence number of 10, rises to approximately 77% at a co-occurrence number of 100, and then plateaus around 77% until a co-occurrence number of 1000. Finally, the “IKE” line is teal with star markers and starts at approximately 64% at a co-occurrence number of 10, rises to approximately 75% at a co-occurrence number of 100, and then plateaus around 75% until a co-occurrence number of 1000.
